title: Historical treasure adventure

destinations.name: Seoul → Gyeongju
destinations.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Gyeongju. Let us discover its historical treasures!
destinations.approachLine: We are nearly in Gyeongju. The last treasure is waiting.
destinations.deliveryLine: We have arrived in Gyeongju! Let us open the treasure chest with the treasures we found.
destinations.landingFact: Cheomseongdae is a raised stone structure used to observe the stars. The old book Samguk Yusa says it was built during the reign of Queen Seondeok of Silla.
destinations.factSource: [출처 : 경주 첨성대 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0002925, [출처 : 첨성대 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0056197 (2026-11-08 확인)

routes.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Gyeongju, following the Gyeongbu Expressway (Cheonan, Daegu). Let us find historical treasures!

destinations.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Busan. Let us discover its historical treasures!
destinations.approachLine: We are nearly in Busan. The last treasure is waiting.
destinations.deliveryLine: We have arrived in Busan! Let us open the treasure chest with the treasures we found.
destinations.landingFact: The building now used as the Provisional Capital Memorial Hall was a presidential residence and workplace during the Korean War. It became a museum in 1984.

routes.name: Gyeongbu Expressway (Suwon, Daejeon)
routes.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Busan, following the Gyeongbu Expressway (Suwon, Daejeon). Let us find historical treasures!

routes.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Busan, following the Jungbu Naeryuk Expressway (Chungju, Mungyeong). Let us find historical treasures!

destinations.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Andong. Let us discover its historical treasures!
destinations.approachLine: We are nearly in Andong. The last treasure is waiting.
destinations.deliveryLine: We have arrived in Andong! Let us open the treasure chest with the treasures we found.
destinations.landingFact: Hahoe Village and Yangdong Village were inscribed together on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2010.
destinations.factSource: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1324/ (Date of Inscription 2010), [출처 : 안동 하회마을 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0034689 (2026-11-08 확인)

routes.name: Jungang Expressway (Danyang, Yeongju)
routes.departureLine: Today we travel from Seoul to Andong, following the Jungang Expressway (Danyang, Yeongju). Let us find historical treasures!

destinations.name: Daejeon → Seoul
destinations.departureLine: Today we travel from Daejeon to Seoul. Let us discover its historical treasures!
destinations.approachLine: We are nearly in Seoul. The last treasure is waiting.
destinations.deliveryLine: We have arrived in Seoul! Let us open the treasure chest with the treasures we found.
destinations.landingFact: Gyeongbokgung was first built in 1395 as the main palace of Joseon.

routes.name: Gyeongbu Expressway (Cheonan, Suwon)
routes.departureLine: Today we travel from Daejeon to Seoul, following the Gyeongbu Expressway (Cheonan, Suwon). Let us find historical treasures!

missions.briefing: Captain, drops of water can blur the treasure map. Remember, the key on our map is blue.
missions.event: Swish! We wiped the drops away, just like windshield wipers. Now we can see the map again.
missions.question: Is the treasure chest key blue or red?
missions.correctLine: Blue! That is right. We found the treasure map piece.
missions.wrongLine: The key was blue. We found the treasure map piece.
missions.fallbackEvent: There are no drops on our map today. We can see it clearly!

missions.briefing: There is a crossroads ahead. The treasure marker is shaped like a star.
missions.event: Sparkle! The crossroads treasure marker has appeared.
missions.question: Is the treasure marker a star or a heart?
missions.correctLine: That is right, a star! We found the crossroads token.
missions.wrongLine: The marker was a star. We found the crossroads token.

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Cheonan. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Cheonan! Independence Hall collects and displays materials about the independence movement. It opened on August 15, 1987.
missions.question: Did Independence Hall open on August 15 or March 1?
missions.correctLine: That is right, August 15! We found the independence flag.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is August 15. We found the independence flag.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 독립기념관 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0015975 (독립운동에 관한 유물과 자료를 수집·전시, 1987년 8월 15일 개관, 2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Daegu. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Daegu! In 1907, a campaign began here to repay the national debt through public donations.
missions.question: Was the campaign about repaying debt or expanding territory?
missions.correctLine: That is right, repaying debt! We found a love-of-country coin.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is repaying debt. We found a love-of-country coin.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 국채보상운동 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0006527 (1907년 2월 대구 광문사에서 제창, 국채를 국민들의 모금으로 갚기 위한 운동, 2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Suwon. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Suwon! Hwaseong Fortress was built during King Jeongjo's reign. It was completed in 1796 and listed by UNESCO in 1997.
missions.question: Was Hwaseong built under King Jeongjo or King Sejong?
missions.correctLine: That is right, King Jeongjo! We found a Hwaseong brick.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is King Jeongjo. We found a Hwaseong brick.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 수원 화성 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0064671 (정조, 1796년 완성), https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/817 (Date of Inscription 1997) (2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Daejeon. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Daejeon! This city was also called Hanbat in the past.
missions.question: Was Daejeon once called Hanbat or Hanyang?
missions.correctLine: That is right, Hanbat! We found a Hanbat seed.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is Hanbat. We found a Hanbat seed.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 대전광역시 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0014708 (「대전(大田: 한밭)이라고 불렸다」, 2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Chungju. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Chungju! Tangeumdae was named after Ureuk playing the gayageum here.
missions.question: Did Ureuk play the gayageum or the geomungo?
missions.correctLine: That is right, the gayageum! We found a gayageum string.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is the gayageum. We found a gayageum string.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 충주 탄금대 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0058228 (「탄금대라는 명칭도 우륵이 가야금을 타던 곳이라는 데에서 유래한다」, 2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Mungyeong. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Mungyeong! Before trains, a major road between Seoul and Busan crossed Mungyeong Saejae. Three Joseon-era gates stand here.
missions.question: Are there three gates or five gates at Mungyeong Saejae?
missions.correctLine: That is right, three! We found a Saejae straw shoe.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is three. We found a Saejae straw shoe.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 조령 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0051706 (철도가 없던 옛날 서울∼부산 간 주요 도로가 대개 이 고개를 통함, 조선시대에 축성한 제1·2·3관문), [출처 : 문경새재 도립공원 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0019398 (새재가 조령) (2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Danyang. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Danyang! Dodam Sambong is made up of three peaks rising from the Namhan River.
missions.question: Do the three peaks stand in the Namhan River or the Nakdong River?
missions.correctLine: That is right, the Namhan River! We found a Sambong pebble.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is the Namhan River. We found a Sambong pebble.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 단양팔경 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0013634 (「도담삼봉은 남한강 물줄기 가운데 솟은 세 개의 봉우리」), [출처 : 단양 도담삼봉 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0068786 (2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our next treasure is near Yeongju. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are near Yeongju! The monk Uisang founded Buseoksa in 676. It joined the UNESCO World Heritage List with other mountain monasteries in 2018.
missions.question: Was Buseoksa founded by Uisang or Wonhyo?
missions.correctLine: That is right, Uisang! We found a Buseoksa roof tile.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is Uisang. We found a Buseoksa roof tile.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 봉황산 부석사 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0024295 (676년 의상 창건, 2018년 산사 세계유산), https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1562 (2026-11-09 확인)

missions.briefing: Our Gyeongju treasure is near an old stone observatory. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are in Gyeongju! People of Silla observed the stars at Cheomseongdae.
missions.question: Were the people observing stars at Cheomseongdae from Silla or Joseon?
missions.correctLine: That is right, Silla! We found the Cheomseongdae treasure.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is Silla. We found the Cheomseongdae treasure.
missions.factSource: [출처 : 경주 첨성대 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0002925, [출처 : 첨성대 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0056197 (2026-11-08 확인)

missions.briefing: Our Busan treasure is near a former presidential residence. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are in Busan! During the Korean War, national government work took place here. The presidential residence remains in the city.
missions.question: Was the wartime government based in Busan or Jeju?
missions.correctLine: That is right, Busan! We found the temporary capital treasure.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is Busan. We found the temporary capital treasure.

missions.briefing: Our Andong treasure is in a village of old houses. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are in Andong! Hahoe is a village where people of one clan have lived together for a long time. Its old houses remain today.
missions.question: Was Hahoe home to one clan or people from many countries?
missions.correctLine: That is right, one clan! We found the Hahoe village treasure.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is one clan. We found the Hahoe village treasure.
missions.factSource: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1324/ (Date of Inscription 2010), [출처 : 안동 하회마을 - 한국민족문화대백과사전] https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0034689 (2026-11-08 확인)

missions.briefing: Our Seoul treasure is near an old royal palace. I will tell you when we get close.
missions.event: We are in Seoul! Gyeongbokgung was the main palace of the kings of Joseon.
missions.question: Is Gyeongbokgung a palace of Joseon or Silla?
missions.correctLine: That is right, Joseon! We found the Gyeongbokgung treasure.
missions.wrongLine: The answer is Joseon. We found the Gyeongbokgung treasure.

finalLine: We are nearly at the last treasure!
endingLine: We brought our treasures together. What a wonderful adventure, Captain!
credits: Historical sources: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture (encykorea.aks.ac.kr), UNESCO World Heritage Centre (whc.unesco.org)
